title: Strong Teacher Not Needed? On Distillation in LLM Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2605.23857v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Knowledge distillation generally assumes a strong-to-weak relationship where stronger teachers yield better students. In this work, we examine this assumption about distillation in large language model pretraining. By varying architecture sizes and training token budgets, we create strong-to-weak, same-level, and weak-to-strong teacher-student relationships, and study distillation's effectiveness under each. We find that the teacher need not be strong: with proper mixing of the language modeling and knowledge distillation losses, even small and undertrained teachers improve larger students. At the same time, a stronger teacher is not always better: pushing the teacher further, through more parameters or more training tokens, can saturate or even reverse the distillation gains. We further observe that distillation improves generalization (out-of-distribution and downstream performance) more readily than in-domain fitting. Togeth

translated_title: 强大的教师并非必需？论大语言模型预训练中的知识蒸馏
translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏通常假设一种“强到弱”的关系，即更强的教师能培养出更好的学生。在这项工作中，我们检验了这一假设在大语言模型预训练蒸馏中的适用性。通过改变模型架构规模和训练token预算，我们构建了强到弱、同级以及弱到强的师生关系，并研究了蒸馏在每种情况下的有效性。我们发现，教师并不需要很强大：通过恰当混合语言建模损失与知识蒸馏损失，即使是小型且训练不足的教师也能提升更大规模学生模型的表现。与此同时，更强的教师并不总是更好：通过增加参数量或训练token数来进一步增强教师，可能使蒸馏收益趋于饱和，甚至出现逆转。我们还进一步观察到，蒸馏更倾向于提升模型的泛化能力（分布外性能和下游任务表现），而非域内拟合能力。
tldr: 大语言模型预训练中的知识蒸馏并不需要强大的教师——即使是小型或训练不足的教师，在恰当混合两种损失后也能有效提升更大规模学生模型的性能，而过强的教师反而可能使蒸馏收益饱和或逆转，且蒸馏更利于提升泛化能力而非域内拟合。
en_tdlr: Knowledge distillation in LLM pretraining does not require a strong teacher—small or undertrained teachers can effectively improve larger students when losses are properly mixed, while overly strong teachers can saturate or even reverse distillation gains, and distillation enhances generalization more readily than in-domain fitting.
